title: Protein timing
text: Consuming protein within a few hours after resistance training can support muscle protein synthesis and recovery. Aim for 20-40g of high-quality protein post-workout.

title: Hydration and performance
text: Proper hydration is critical for athletic performance. Even 2% bodyweight loss in fluids can reduce endurance and cognitive function.

title: Creatine basics
text: Creatine monohydrate is one of the most studied supplements. Typical dosing includes a short loading phase or a lower daily maintenance dose; follow evidence-based guidance and consult a professional for personal decisions.
